cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login signs in with a valid email and password and returns the user.
procedure: Send POST request to /api/auth/login.
Request headers: Content-Type: application/json.
Request JSON body: { "email": "thuky@trustcabinet.local", "password": "TrustCabinet@2026" }.
expected: Response JSON body contains accessToken, accessTokenExpiresAt and user.
user.capabilities lists the capabilities of the Secretary role (for example MeetingCreator).
precondition: Backend is running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local exists, is active and has the Secretary role.
User is not signed in.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login never returns the password or its hash.
procedure: Send POST request to /api/auth/login.
Request headers: Content-Type: application/json.
Request JSON body: { "email": "thuky@trustcabinet.local", "password": "TrustCabinet@2026" }.
Read the raw response body.
expected: The response body contains no field named password or passwordHash.
The response body does not contain the text TrustCabinet@2026.
precondition: Backend is running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local exists and is active.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login returns MSG01 for an unknown email, a wrong password or empty fields.
procedure: Send POST request to /api/auth/login with body { "email": "khong-ton-tai@trustcabinet.local", "password": "TrustCabinet@2026" }.
Send POST request to /api/auth/login with body { "email": "thuky@trustcabinet.local", "password": "SaiMatKhau@2026" }.
Send POST request to /api/auth/login with body { "email": "", "password": "" }.
Request headers for each request: Content-Type: application/json.
expected: Each response JSON body has code "MSG01".
The three responses are identical, so they do not reveal whether the email exists.
precondition: Backend is running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local exists and is active.
No account uses khong-ton-tai@trustcabinet.local.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login returns MSG02 for a deactivated account.
procedure: Send POST request to /api/auth/login.
Request headers: Content-Type: application/json.
Request JSON body: { "email": "thuky@trustcabinet.local", "password": "TrustCabinet@2026" }.
expected: Response JSON body: { "code": "MSG02", "message": "Tài khoản không khả dụng. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên." }.
precondition: Backend is running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local exists with the correct password but has been deactivated by an administrator.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login succeeds for a role that grants no capability.
procedure: Send POST request to /api/auth/login.
Request headers: Content-Type: application/json.
Request JSON body: { "email": "chutoa@trustcabinet.local", "password": "TrustCabinet@2026" }.
expected: Response JSON body contains an accessToken.
precondition: Backend is running.
Account chutoa@trustcabinet.local is active.
Its role has no capability ticked in the role matrix.

cases.description: Verify a rejected sign-in carries its Vietnamese message.
procedure: Send POST request to /api/auth/login.
Request headers: Content-Type: application/json.
Request JSON body: { "email": "thuky@trustcabinet.local", "password": "SaiMatKhau@2026" }.
expected: Response JSON body: { "code": "MSG01", "message": "Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng." }.
precondition: Backend is running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local exists and is active.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login puts the refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie and not in the body.
procedure: Send POST request to /api/auth/login.
Request headers: Content-Type: application/json.
Request JSON body: { "email": "thuky@trustcabinet.local", "password": "TrustCabinet@2026" }.
Inspect the Set-Cookie response header and the response body.
expected: Set-Cookie header sets tc_refresh_token with HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, Path=/api/auth and Max-Age=604800 (7 days).
The response body has no refreshToken field and does not contain the cookie value.
precondition: Backend is running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local exists and is active.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/auth/me returns the signed-in user.
procedure: Sign in with POST /api/auth/login as thuky@trustcabinet.local / TrustCabinet@2026 and copy accessToken.
Send GET request to /api/auth/me.
Request headers: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
Request body: None (GET request).
expected: Response JSON body: email "thuky@trustcabinet.local", roleName "Thư ký" and the capabilities of the Secretary role.
precondition: Backend is running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local exists and is active.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/auth/me returns 401 when no access token is sent.
procedure: Send GET request to /api/auth/me.
Request headers: None (no authentication).
Request body: None (GET request).
precondition: Backend is running.
Request is sent without authentication.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/auth/me rejects a malformed or forged access token.
procedure: Send GET request to /api/auth/me with header Authorization: Bearer khong-phai-token.
Send GET request to /api/auth/me with header Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJrZSB0cm9tIn0.giaMaoChuKy (a token not signed by the server).
Request body: None (GET request).
precondition: Backend is running.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/refresh exchanges the refresh token for a new token pair.
procedure: Sign in with POST /api/auth/login as thuky@trustcabinet.local and keep the tc_refresh_token cookie.
Send POST request to /api/auth/refresh.
Request headers: Cookie: tc_refresh_token=<refresh token from step 1>.
Request body: None.
expected: Response JSON body contains a new accessToken.
Set-Cookie header sets tc_refresh_token to a value different from the one sent.
precondition: Backend and Redis are running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local exists and is active.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/refresh rejects a refresh token that was already used.
procedure: Sign in as thuky@trustcabinet.local and keep the tc_refresh_token cookie.
Send POST request to /api/auth/refresh with that cookie.
Send POST request to /api/auth/refresh again with the same, already used cookie.
expected: The first refresh returns HTTP 200 OK.
The second refresh returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
precondition: Backend and Redis are running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local exists and is active.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/refresh without the cookie answers like an expired session.
procedure: Send POST request to /api/auth/refresh.
Request headers: None (no tc_refresh_token cookie).
Request body: None.
expected: Response JSON body: { "code": "MSG01", "message": "Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại." }.
precondition: Backend is running.
Client holds no refresh token cookie.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/refresh returns MSG02 once the account has been deactivated.
procedure: Sign in as thuky@trustcabinet.local and keep the tc_refresh_token cookie.
As quantri@trustcabinet.local, deactivate thuky@trustcabinet.local on the user management screen.
Send POST request to /api/auth/refresh with the cookie from step 1.
expected: The refresh token can no longer be used.
precondition: Backend and Redis are running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local is active at step 1.
Administrator quantri@trustcabinet.local is available.

cases.description: Verify a refused refresh clears the refresh token cookie.
procedure: Sign in as thuky@trustcabinet.local and keep the tc_refresh_token cookie.
Send POST request to /api/auth/refresh with that cookie.
Send POST request to /api/auth/refresh again with the same cookie.
Inspect the Set-Cookie header of the second response.
expected: The second refresh returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Set-Cookie header clears tc_refresh_token (empty value, Max-Age=0).
precondition: Backend and Redis are running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local exists and is active.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/refresh ignores a refresh token sent in the request body.
procedure: Sign in as thuky@trustcabinet.local and copy the tc_refresh_token cookie value.
Send POST request to /api/auth/refresh without the cookie.
Request headers: Content-Type: application/json.
Request JSON body: { "refreshToken": "<value from step 1>" }.
expected: No new token pair is issued.
precondition: Backend and Redis are running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local exists and is active.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/logout ends the session on the server and clears the cookie.
procedure: Sign in as thuky@trustcabinet.local and keep the tc_refresh_token cookie.
Send POST request to /api/auth/logout with that cookie.
Send POST request to /api/auth/refresh with the same cookie.
expected: The refresh after logout returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
precondition: Backend and Redis are running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local exists and is active.

cases.description: Verify signing out twice is not an error.
procedure: Sign in as thuky@trustcabinet.local and keep the tc_refresh_token cookie.
Send POST request to /api/auth/logout with that cookie.
Send POST request to /api/auth/logout again with the same cookie.
expected: Both requests return HTTP 204 No Content.
The second response does not reveal that the session had already ended.
precondition: Backend and Redis are running.
Account thuky@trustcabinet.local exists and is active.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/logout clears the cookie even without a valid refresh token.
procedure: Send POST request to /api/auth/logout.
Request headers: None (no cookie).
Request body: None.
precondition: Backend is running.
Client holds no refresh token.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/google signs in a linked, active account.
procedure: Sign in to Google in the browser with the Gmail account linked to thuky@trustcabinet.local and obtain its ID token from the login page.
Send POST request to /api/auth/google.
Request headers: Content-Type: application/json.
Request JSON body: { "idToken": "<Google ID token>" }.
expected: Response JSON body contains accessToken and user with email thuky@trustcabinet.local and roleName "Thư ký".
precondition: Backend is running with Google sign-in enabled.
The Google account is linked to thuky@trustcabinet.local, which is active.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/google returns the same response shape as password sign-in.
procedure: Obtain a Google ID token for the linked account.
Send POST request to /api/auth/google with body { "idToken": "<Google ID token>" }.
Compare the response body with the body of POST /api/auth/login.
expected: Response JSON body has the fields accessToken, accessTokenExpiresAt and user, as /api/auth/login does.
The body has no refreshToken field.
precondition: Backend is running with Google sign-in enabled.
The Google account is linked to an active internal account.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/google returns MSG03 for an empty or invalid ID token.
procedure: Send POST request to /api/auth/google with body { "idToken": "" }.
Send POST request to /api/auth/google with body { "idToken": "khong-phai-id-token" }.
Request headers for each request: Content-Type: application/json.
expected: Each response JSON body: { "code": "MSG03", "message": "Đăng nhập bằng Google không thành công." }.
precondition: Backend is running with Google sign-in enabled.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/google returns MSG05 for a Google account no internal account uses.
procedure: Sign in to Google with a Gmail account that has no TrustCabinet account (for example nguoi.la@gmail.com) and obtain its ID token.
Send POST request to /api/auth/google with body { "idToken": "<Google ID token>" }.
precondition: Backend is running with Google sign-in enabled.
No internal account is linked to, or has the email of, that Google account.

cases.description: Verify an account an administrator created with a Gmail address signs in with Google without manual linking.
procedure: As quantri@trustcabinet.local, create an account whose email is the tester's Gmail address.
Sign in to Google with that Gmail account and obtain its ID token.
Send POST request to /api/auth/google with body { "idToken": "<Google ID token>" }.
expected: HTTP 200 OK response with an access token.
The account is now linked to the Google account.
The audit log records one user.google_linked entry.
precondition: Backend is running with Google sign-in enabled.
The new account is active and not yet linked to any Google account.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/google returns MSG02 for a deactivated linked account.
procedure: Obtain a Google ID token for the Google account linked to a deactivated account.
Send POST request to /api/auth/google with body { "idToken": "<Google ID token>" }.
precondition: Backend is running with Google sign-in enabled.
The Google account is linked to an internal account that has been deactivated.

cases.description: Verify an account deactivated before its first Google sign-in returns MSG02.
procedure: Obtain a Google ID token for the Gmail address of the deactivated, unlinked account.
Send POST request to /api/auth/google with body { "idToken": "<Google ID token>" }.
expected: Response JSON body: { "code": "MSG02", "message": "Tài khoản không khả dụng. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên." }.
The account is not linked to the Google account.
precondition: Backend is running with Google sign-in enabled.
An internal account with that Gmail address exists, is deactivated and has never been linked to Google.

cases.description: Verify Google sign-in succeeds for a role that grants no capability.
procedure: Obtain a Google ID token for the Google account linked to chutoa@trustcabinet.local.
Send POST request to /api/auth/google with body { "idToken": "<Google ID token>" }.
precondition: Backend is running with Google sign-in enabled.
The linked account is active and its role has no capability.

cases.description: Verify a rejected Google sign-in carries its Vietnamese message.
procedure: Obtain a Google ID token for a Gmail account with no TrustCabinet account.
Send POST request to /api/auth/google with body { "idToken": "<Google ID token>" }.
expected: Response JSON body: { "code": "MSG05", "message": "Tài khoản Google này chưa được cấp quyền truy cập hệ thống." }.
precondition: Backend is running with Google sign-in enabled.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/google is not available when Google sign-in is switched off.
procedure: Set Authentication:Google:Enabled to false and restart the backend.
Send POST request to /api/auth/google with body { "idToken": "<a valid Google ID token>" }.
expected: No token is issued, even for a valid ID token.
precondition: Backend is running with Google sign-in disabled.
